source.anchor: Original Samplinglib supplement: The linear Itô term and its completed martingale. Exact assumptions and formula below.
source.original_text:
Take the almost surely compact-range Euclidean process built from initialized drift time primitives and completed stochastic integrals. For a continuously Fréchet differentiable test on that range, the left-endpoint derivative sums converge in measure to the integral of the derivative applied to the drift vector plus the terminal value of a genuine martingale.

The horizon T is positive and the sample measure is finite. The filtration satisfies the usual conditions and the standard vector Brownian motion is relative to that filtration and measure.
The state and Brownian coordinate types are finite with decidable equality. Each diffusion entry is progressive and square-integrable in the product of sample and horizon time measures.
The compact set K has a selected fallback point k₀. On one event of full measure, the process belongs to K at every time in [0,T].
Each initial coordinate is strongly measurable at time zero. Each drift coordinate is strongly progressive and has almost surely integrable time sections on the horizon.
The scalar test is continuously Fréchet differentiable at each point of K.

\sum_k Df(X_{t_k})[\Delta_kX]\xrightarrow{\mu}\int_{[0,T]}Df(X_s)[b(s)]\,ds+M_T.

theorem anonymous_target.{u_1,
    u_2, u_3}
  {Ω : Type u_1} {I : Type u_2} {J : Type u_3} [MeasurableSpace Ω] [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I] [Fintype J]
  [DecidableEq J] {filtration : MeasureTheory.Filtration NNReal inferInstance} {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω}
  [MeasureTheory.IsFiniteMeasure μ] {T : NNReal} {B : NNReal → Ω → EuclideanSpace ℝ J}
  (hB :
    AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.StochasticProcesses.BrownianMotion.IsStandardBrownianMotionWithFiltration B
      filtration μ)
  (hT : 0 < T)
  (hUsual : AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.StochasticProcesses.ProgressiveL2.SatisfiesUsualConditions filtration μ)
  (η :
    I → J → AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.StochasticProcesses.ProgressiveL2.ProgressiveL2Integrand filtration μ T)
  (x : Ω → I → ℝ) (hx : ∀ (i : I), MeasureTheory.StronglyMeasurable fun ω => x ω i) (b : I → NNReal → Ω → ℝ)
  (hb : ∀ (i : I), MeasureTheory.IsStronglyProgressive filtration (b i))
  (hbi :
    ∀ (i : I),
      ∀ᵐ (ω : Ω) ∂μ,
        MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun s => b i s ω)
          (AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.StochasticProcesses.TimeMeasure.upTo T))
  {K : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ I)} (hK : IsCompact K) (fallback : ↑K) (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ I → ℝ)
  (hf : ∀ x ∈ K, ContDiffAt ℝ 1 f x) :
  have A := fun i t ω =>
    x ω i +
      AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.StochasticProcesses.ProgressiveDriftIntegral.prefixIntegralProcess (b i) t ω;
  have X := fun t ω =>
    WithLp.toLp 2 fun i =>
      A i t ω +
        ∑ j,
          AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.StochasticProcesses.ItoIntegralProcess.itoIntegralProcess (η i j) hT ⋯
            hUsual t ω;
  (∀ᵐ (ω : Ω) ∂μ, ∀ t ≤ T, X t ω ∈ K) →
    ∃ θ,
      (∀ᵐ (ω : Ω) ∂μ,
          ∀ (q : I × J) (t : NNReal),
            (θ q).process t ω =
              (fderiv ℝ f (X (Min.min t T) ω)) ((EuclideanSpace.basisFun I ℝ) q.1) * (η q.1 q.2).process t ω) ∧
        have M := fun t ω =>
          ∑ q,
            AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.StochasticProcesses.ItoIntegralProcess.itoIntegralProcess (θ q) hT ⋯
              hUsual t ω;
        MeasureTheory.Martingale M filtration μ ∧
          (∀ (ω : Ω), M 0 ω = 0) ∧
            MeasureTheory.TendstoInMeasure μ
              (fun n ω =>
                have t :=
                  AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.StochasticProcesses.SampledElementaryApproximation.regularGridTimes
                    (AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.StochasticProcesses.SampledElementaryApproximation.dyadicMesh T
                      n)
                    (2 ^ n);
                ∑ i, (fderiv ℝ f (X (t i.castSucc) ω)) (X (t i.succ) ω - X (t i.castSucc) ω))
              Filter.atTop fun ω =>
              ∫ (s : NNReal),
                  (fderiv ℝ f (X s ω))
                    (WithLp.toLp 2 fun i =>
                      b i s ω) ∂AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.StochasticProcesses.TimeMeasure.upTo T +
                M T ω

blind_reconstruction.text:
State coordinate type I and Brownian coordinate type J; x,b,eta; process X; compact K with supplied fallback∈K; scalar f; existential integrands theta indexed by I×J and their summed integral M.

Omega is measurable with finite measure mu and a filtration F indexed by nonnegative reals. T>0 is fixed. The Euclidean coordinate type J is finite with decidable equality. B:[0,infinity)×Omega→R^J. lambda_T denotes the pullback under NNReal.toReal of Lebesgue measure restricted to [0,T]. I is finite with decidable equality. x:Omega→(I→R); b_i scalar processes; eta_ij progressive L² integrands; f:R^I→R; K⊆R^I.

Assumptions: B starts at zero for every omega, has jointly independent increments over disjoint half-open intervals, every continuous real linear functional ell sends B_t-B_s (s<t) to a centered Gaussian of variance (t-s)||ell||², and paths are continuous mu-a.e. B is strongly adapted to F and B_t-B_s is independent of F_s for s≤t. F is right-continuous and every subset S⊆Omega with mu(S)=0 belongs to F_t for every t≥0. A progressive L² integrand is a real process a(t,omega), strongly progressive for F, for which (omega,t)↦a(t,omega) is in L²(mu⊗lambda_T). Each x_i is strongly measurable for F_0. Every b_i is strongly progressive and is lambda_T-integrable pathwise mu-a.e. K is compact, fallback∈K, and f is ambient C¹ at every x∈K. The range assumption is mu-a.e. omega, for every t≤T, X(t,omega)∈K.

Conclusion: I_j(a)(t,omega) denotes the specified completed Ito integral driven by the scalar coordinate B^j(t,omega)=(B(t,omega))_j. Its representative is the pointwise limit of chosen elementary stochastic integrals off the null complement of their uniform Cauchy event, and zero on that complement; it is held constant after T. Set X_i(t)=x_i+∫b_i(s)d lambda_t(s)+∑_j I_j(eta_ij)(t). There exists theta:I×J→progressive L² integrands such that, on one mu-full set, for every (i,j) and every t≥0, theta_{i,j}(t,omega)=Df(X(min(t,T),omega))[e_i] eta_ij(t,omega). Define M(t)=∑_{(i,j)∈I×J}I_j(theta_{i,j})(t). Then M is an F-martingale, M(0,omega)=0 for every omega, and ∑_{r=0}^{2^n-1}Df(X(t_r^n))[X(t_{r+1}^n)-X(t_r^n)] converges in mu-measure to ∫Df(X(s))[(b_i(s))_i]d lambda_T(s)+M(T), where t_r^n=rT/2^n.

Quantifier order: For every setup and f C¹ at each point of K, if X(t,omega) lies in K for all t≤T on one full-measure set, there exists a family theta_{i,j} of progressive L² integrands with the all-time process equality, and its defined sum M satisfies the remaining claims.

Scope: Theta's equality is a.e. omega simultaneously for every index and all nonnegative t, with X stopped at T in the derivative factor. The convergence is in measure at the fixed horizon, not asserted a.s. or in L¹. M is the specified finite sum, not an independent existential process.

Constant dependencies: theta may depend on all data, including f,K,fallback,T; no uniform error rate or numerical constant.

namespace AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.StochasticProcesses.ItoDyadicLinearTerm

open Filter MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory Set
open scoped BigOperators NNReal Topology
open BrownianMotion ProgressiveL2 ElementaryItoIntegral SampledElementaryApproximation
  DyadicElementaryRefinement EuclideanBrownianCoordinates ItoIntegralProcess

private noncomputable def weightedIncrementSum {Ω : Type*}
    (T : ℝ≥0) (W P : ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℝ) (n : ℕ) (ω : Ω) : ℝ :=
  let t := regularGridTimes (dyadicMesh T n) (2 ^ n)
  ∑ i : Fin (2 ^ n), W (t i.castSucc) ω * (P (t i.succ) ω - P (t i.castSucc) ω)

private theorem aestronglyMeasurable_weightedIncrementSum
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : Measure Ω} {T : ℝ≥0}
    (hT : 0 < T) {W P : ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℝ}
    (hW : ∀ t ≤ T, AEStronglyMeasurable (W t) μ)
    (hP : ∀ t ≤ T, AEStronglyMeasurable (P t) μ) (n : ℕ) :
    AEStronglyMeasurable (weightedIncrementSum T W P n) μ := by
  let t := regularGridTimes (dyadicMesh T n) (2 ^ n)
  have ht (i : Fin (2 ^ n + 1)) : t i ≤ T :=
    ((regularGridTimes_strictMono (dyadicMesh_pos hT n) _).monotone (Fin.le_last i)).trans_eq
      (regularDyadic_last_time T n)
  have hCell (i : Fin (2 ^ n)) :
      AEStronglyMeasurable (fun ω => W (t i.castSucc) ω *
        (P (t i.succ) ω - P (t i.castSucc) ω)) μ :=
    (hW _ (ht _)).mul ((hP _ (ht _)).sub (hP _ (ht _)))
  exact (Finset.aestronglyMeasurable_sum Finset.univ fun i _ => hCell i).congr
    (Eventually.of_forall fun ω => by simp only [weightedIncrementSum, Finset.sum_apply, t])

/-- The first-order Taylor sums converge to the actual drift integral plus
the terminal value of the completed martingale with the derivative integrands. -/
theorem tendstoInMeasure_dyadic_linear_ito_term
    {Ω I J : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I] [Fintype J] [DecidableEq J]
    {filtration : Filtration ℝ≥0 (inferInstance : MeasurableSpace Ω)}
    {μ : Measure Ω} [IsFiniteMeasure μ] {T : ℝ≥0}
    {B : ℝ≥0 → Ω → EuclideanSpace ℝ J}
    (hB : IsStandardBrownianMotionWithFiltration B filtration μ) (hT : 0 < T)
    (hUsual : SatisfiesUsualConditions filtration μ)
    (η : I → J → ProgressiveL2Integrand filtration μ T)
    (x : Ω → I → ℝ) (hx : ∀ i, StronglyMeasurable[filtration 0] (fun ω => x ω i))
    (b : I → ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℝ) (hb : ∀ i, IsStronglyProgressive filtration (b i))
    (hbi : ∀ i, ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, Integrable (fun s => b i s ω) (TimeMeasure.upTo T))
    {K : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ I)} (hK : IsCompact K) (fallback : K) (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ I → ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ x ∈ K, ContDiffAt ℝ 1 f x) :
    let A := fun (i : I) (t : ℝ≥0) (ω : Ω) => x ω i + prefixIntegralProcess (b i) t ω
    let X := fun (t : ℝ≥0) (ω : Ω) => WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i : I => A i t ω + ∑ j : J,
      itoIntegralProcess (η i j) hT ((coordinateFamily hB).isBrownian j) hUsual t ω)
    (∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, ∀ t ≤ T, X t ω ∈ K) →
    ∃ θ : (I × J) → ProgressiveL2Integrand filtration μ T,
      (∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, ∀ q t, (θ q).process t ω =
        fderiv ℝ f (X (min t T) ω) (EuclideanSpace.basisFun I ℝ q.1) *
          (η q.1 q.2).process t ω) ∧
      let M := fun (t : ℝ≥0) (ω : Ω) => ∑ q : I × J,
        itoIntegralProcess (θ q) hT ((coordinateFamily hB).isBrownian q.2) hUsual t ω
      Martingale M filtration μ ∧ (∀ ω, M 0 ω = 0) ∧
      TendstoInMeasure μ (fun n ω =>
        let t := regularGridTimes (dyadicMesh T n) (2 ^ n)
        ∑ i : Fin (2 ^ n), fderiv ℝ f (X (t i.castSucc) ω)
          (X (t i.succ) ω - X (t i.castSucc) ω)) atTop
        (fun ω => (∫ s, fderiv ℝ f (X s ω) (WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i : I => b i s ω))
          ∂(TimeMeasure.upTo T)) + M T ω) := by
  intro A X hRange
  let e := EuclideanSpace.basisFun I ℝ
  let W (i : I) (t : ℝ≥0) (ω : Ω) :=
    fderiv ℝ f (restrictState fallback (X (min t T) ω) : EuclideanSpace ℝ I) (e i)
  let N (q : I × J) := itoIntegralProcess (η q.1 q.2) hT
    ((coordinateFamily hB).isBrownian q.2) hUsual
  have hA i := initialized_drift_progressive_continuous_boundedVariation
    (fun ω => x ω i) (hx i) (b i) (hb i) (hbi i)
  have hAp (i : I) : IsStronglyProgressive filtration (A i) := (hA i).1
  have hAeq (i : I) (s : ℝ≥0) (hs : s ≤ T) (ω : Ω) :
      A i s ω = x ω i + prefixIntegral (fun r => b i r ω) T s := (hA i).2.1 s hs ω
  have hW i := euclidean_ito_gradient_weight_progressive_bounded hB hT hUsual η A hAp
    (fun j => (hA j).2.2.mono fun _ h => h.1) hK fallback f hf i hRange
  have hWp (i : I) : IsStronglyProgressive filtration (W i) := (hW i).1
  have hWc (i : I) : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, ContinuousOn (fun t => W i t ω) (Icc 0 T) := (hW i).2.1
  choose C hC using fun i => (hW i).2.2
  have hNoise (q : I × J) := tendstoInMeasure_dyadic_weighted_ito_sums
    (η q.1 q.2) hT ((coordinateFamily hB).isBrownian q.2) hUsual (W q.1)
    (hWp q.1) (hWc q.1) (hC q.1)
  choose θ hθ hN using hNoise
  let L (q : I × J) := itoIntegralProcess (θ q) hT
    ((coordinateFamily hB).isBrownian q.2) hUsual
  let M (t : ℝ≥0) (ω : Ω) := ∑ q : I × J, L q t ω
  have hMart (s : Finset (I × J)) : Martingale (∑ q ∈ s, L q) filtration μ := by
    induction s using Finset.induction_on with
    | empty => simpa only [Finset.sum_empty] using (martingale_zero (E := ℝ) filtration μ)
    | insert q s hq ih =>
      rw [Finset.sum_insert hq]
      exact (itoIntegralProcess_martingale (θ q) hT
        ((coordinateFamily hB).isBrownian q.2) hUsual).add ih
  have hM : Martingale M filtration μ := by
    have hEq : M = ∑ q : I × J, L q := by
      funext t ω
      simp only [M, Finset.sum_apply]
    rw [hEq]
    exact hMart Finset.univ
  have hZero (ω : Ω) : M 0 ω = 0 := by
    simp only [M, L, itoIntegralProcess_at_zero, Pi.zero_apply, Finset.sum_const_zero]
  refine ⟨θ, ?_, hM, hZero, ?_⟩
  · filter_upwards [hRange] with ω hr q t
    rw [hθ]
    dsimp only [W, e]
    rw [coe_restrictState_of_mem fallback (hr _ (min_le_right _ _))]
  let t (n : ℕ) := regularGridTimes (dyadicMesh T n) (2 ^ n)
  have ht (n : ℕ) (i : Fin (2 ^ n + 1)) : t n i ≤ T :=
    ((regularGridTimes_strictMono (dyadicMesh_pos hT n) _).monotone (Fin.le_last i)).trans_eq
      (regularDyadic_last_time T n)
  let F (i : I) := weightedIncrementSum T (W i) (A i)
  let G (q : I × J) := weightedIncrementSum T (W q.1) (N q)
  let D (i : I) (ω : Ω) := ∫ s, W i s ω * b i s ω ∂(TimeMeasure.upTo T)
  have hFromProg {P : ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℝ} (h : IsStronglyProgressive filtration P)
      (s : ℝ≥0) (_ : s ≤ T) : AEStronglyMeasurable (P s) μ :=
    ((h.stronglyAdapted s).mono (filtration.le s)).aestronglyMeasurable
  have hFm (i : I) (n : ℕ) : AEStronglyMeasurable (F i n) μ :=
    aestronglyMeasurable_weightedIncrementSum hT (hFromProg (hWp i)) (hFromProg (hAp i)) n
  have hGm (q : I × J) (n : ℕ) : AEStronglyMeasurable (G q n) μ :=
    aestronglyMeasurable_weightedIncrementSum hT (hFromProg (hWp q.1)) (fun s _ =>
      ((itoIntegralProcess_stronglyAdapted (η q.1 q.2) hT ((coordinateFamily hB).isBrownian q.2)
        hUsual s).mono (filtration.le s)).aestronglyMeasurable) n
  have hF (i : I) : TendstoInMeasure μ (F i) atTop (D i) := by
    apply tendstoInMeasure_of_tendsto_ae (hFm i)
    filter_upwards [hWc i, hbi i] with ω hw hi
    have hlim := tendsto_dyadic_weighted_prefixIntegral_sums
      (fun s => W i s ω) (fun s => b i s ω) T hT hw hi
    refine (tendsto_congr' (Eventually.of_forall fun n => ?_)).2 hlim
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro k _
    rw [hAeq i _ (ht n k.succ) ω, hAeq i _ (ht n k.castSucc) ω,
      add_sub_add_left_eq_sub]
  have hG (q : I × J) : TendstoInMeasure μ (G q) atTop (L q T) := hN q
  have hSum : TendstoInMeasure μ
      (fun n ω => (∑ i : I, F i n ω) + ∑ q : I × J, G q n ω) atTop
      (fun ω => (∑ i : I, D i ω) + M T ω) := by
    let S : I ⊕ (I × J) → ℕ → Ω → ℝ := Sum.elim F G
    let Q : I ⊕ (I × J) → Ω → ℝ := Sum.elim D (fun q => L q T)
    have hS (k : I ⊕ (I × J)) (n : ℕ) : AEStronglyMeasurable (S k n) μ := by
      cases k with
      | inl i => exact hFm i n
      | inr q => exact hGm q n
    have hQ (k : I ⊕ (I × J)) : TendstoInMeasure μ (S k) atTop (Q k) := by
      cases k with
      | inl i => exact hF i
      | inr q => exact hG q
    simpa only [S, Q, Fintype.sum_sum_type, Sum.elim_inl, Sum.elim_inr, M] using
      tendstoInMeasure_fintype_sum hS hQ
  have hExpand (l : EuclideanSpace ℝ I →L[ℝ] ℝ) (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ I) :
      l v = ∑ i : I, l (e i) * v i := by
    have h : (∑ i : I, v i • e i) = v := by
      simpa only [e, EuclideanSpace.basisFun_repr] using e.sum_repr v
    calc
      l v = l (∑ i : I, v i • e i) := congrArg l h.symm
      _ = _ := by simp only [map_sum, map_smul, smul_eq_mul, mul_comm]
  refine TendstoInMeasure.congr ?_ ?_ hSum
  · intro n
    filter_upwards [hRange] with ω hr
    simp only [F, G, weightedIncrementSum, Fintype.sum_prod_type]
    change ((∑ i : I, ∑ k : Fin (2 ^ n), W i (t n k.castSucc) ω *
      (A i (t n k.succ) ω - A i (t n k.castSucc) ω)) +
      ∑ i : I, ∑ j : J, ∑ k : Fin (2 ^ n), W i (t n k.castSucc) ω *
        (N (i, j) (t n k.succ) ω - N (i, j) (t n k.castSucc) ω)) =
      ∑ k : Fin (2 ^ n), fderiv ℝ f (X (t n k.castSucc) ω)
        (X (t n k.succ) ω - X (t n k.castSucc) ω)
    have hSwap (i : I) : (∑ j : J, ∑ k : Fin (2 ^ n), W i (t n k.castSucc) ω *
        (N (i, j) (t n k.succ) ω - N (i, j) (t n k.castSucc) ω)) =
        ∑ k : Fin (2 ^ n), ∑ j : J, W i (t n k.castSucc) ω *
          (N (i, j) (t n k.succ) ω - N (i, j) (t n k.castSucc) ω) := Finset.sum_comm
    simp_rw [hSwap]
    simp_rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro k _
    rw [hExpand]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i _
    rw [← Finset.mul_sum, ← mul_add, Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    simp only [W, min_eq_left (ht n k.castSucc),
      coe_restrictState_of_mem fallback (hr _ (ht n k.castSucc)), X, PiLp.sub_apply, N]
    ring
  · filter_upwards [ae_all_iff.2 hWc, ae_all_iff.2 hbi, hRange] with ω hw hi hr
    let ν := TimeMeasure.upTo T
    have hMem : ∀ᵐ s ∂ν, s ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ≥0) T :=
      (TimeMeasure.ae_mem_Ioc_zero_upTo T).mono fun _ hs => ⟨hs.1.le, hs.2⟩
    have hRest : ν.restrict (Icc 0 T) = ν := Measure.restrict_eq_self_of_ae_mem hMem
    have hInt (i : I) : Integrable (fun s => W i s ω * b i s ω) ν := by
      have hm : AEStronglyMeasurable (fun s => W i s ω) ν := by
        rw [← hRest]
        exact (hw i).aestronglyMeasurable measurableSet_Icc
      exact (hi i).bdd_mul hm (hMem.mono fun s hs => by
        simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using hC i s hs.2 ω)
    apply congrArg (· + M T ω)
    change (∑ i : I, ∫ s, W i s ω * b i s ω ∂ν) =
      ∫ s, fderiv ℝ f (X s ω) (WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i : I => b i s ω)) ∂ν
    rw [← integral_finsetSum _ (fun i _ => hInt i)]
    apply integral_congr_ae
    filter_upwards [hMem] with s hs
    rw [hExpand]
    simp only [W, min_eq_left hs.2, coe_restrictState_of_mem fallback (hr s hs.2)]

end AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.StochasticProcesses.ItoDyadicLinearTerm

notation.text: The initial value, moving time primitive and completed Itô integrals define the vector process.
Each gradient entry uses the time-clipped process. The sum of the completed integrals is a martingale starting at zero.

steps.title: Take the weighted stochastic limits
steps.text: For each coordinate use the progressive bounded derivative weight. Apply the weighted stochastic-sum theorem to each actual completed integral to obtain the progressive L² product integrand.
steps.lean:
intro A X hRange
  let e := EuclideanSpace.basisFun I ℝ
  let W (i : I) (t : ℝ≥0) (ω : Ω) :=
    fderiv ℝ f (restrictState fallback (X (min t T) ω) : EuclideanSpace ℝ I) (e i)
  let N (q : I × J) := itoIntegralProcess (η q.1 q.2) hT
    ((coordinateFamily hB).isBrownian q.2) hUsual
  have hA i := initialized_drift_progressive_continuous_boundedVariation
    (fun ω => x ω i) (hx i) (b i) (hb i) (hbi i)
  have hAp (i : I) : IsStronglyProgressive filtration (A i) := (hA i).1
  have hAeq (i : I) (s : ℝ≥0) (hs : s ≤ T) (ω : Ω) :
      A i s ω = x ω i + prefixIntegral (fun r => b i r ω) T s := (hA i).2.1 s hs ω
  have hW i := euclidean_ito_gradient_weight_progressive_bounded hB hT hUsual η A hAp
    (fun j => (hA j).2.2.mono fun _ h => h.1) hK fallback f hf i hRange
  have hWp (i : I) : IsStronglyProgressive filtration (W i) := (hW i).1
  have hWc (i : I) : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, ContinuousOn (fun t => W i t ω) (Icc 0 T) := (hW i).2.1
  choose C hC using fun i => (hW i).2.2
  have hNoise (q : I × J) := tendstoInMeasure_dyadic_weighted_ito_sums
    (η q.1 q.2) hT ((coordinateFamily hB).isBrownian q.2) hUsual (W q.1)
    (hWp q.1) (hWc q.1) (hC q.1)
  choose θ hθ hN using hNoise

steps.title: Take the weighted drift limit
steps.text: On almost every path, the initialized drift increments are increments of the integrable time primitive. The continuous derivative weight therefore gives the ordinary weighted time-integral limit. Almost-sure convergence implies convergence in measure under the finite sample measure.
steps.lean:
have hF (i : I) : TendstoInMeasure μ (F i) atTop (D i) := by
    apply tendstoInMeasure_of_tendsto_ae (hFm i)
    filter_upwards [hWc i, hbi i] with ω hw hi
    have hlim := tendsto_dyadic_weighted_prefixIntegral_sums
      (fun s => W i s ω) (fun s => b i s ω) T hT hw hi
    refine (tendsto_congr' (Eventually.of_forall fun n => ?_)).2 hlim
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro k _
    rw [hAeq i _ (ht n k.succ) ω, hAeq i _ (ht n k.castSucc) ω,
      add_sub_add_left_eq_sub]

steps.title: Assemble the genuine martingale
steps.text: Each weighted diffusion entry is a progressive L² integrand. Its completed stochastic integral is a martingale. Add them over the finite coordinate pairs. The sum is zero at time zero for every sample.
steps.lean:
let L (q : I × J) := itoIntegralProcess (θ q) hT
    ((coordinateFamily hB).isBrownian q.2) hUsual
  let M (t : ℝ≥0) (ω : Ω) := ∑ q : I × J, L q t ω
  have hMart (s : Finset (I × J)) : Martingale (∑ q ∈ s, L q) filtration μ := by
    induction s using Finset.induction_on with
    | empty => simpa only [Finset.sum_empty] using (martingale_zero (E := ℝ) filtration μ)
    | insert q s hq ih =>
      rw [Finset.sum_insert hq]
      exact (itoIntegralProcess_martingale (θ q) hT
        ((coordinateFamily hB).isBrownian q.2) hUsual).add ih
  have hM : Martingale M filtration μ := by
    have hEq : M = ∑ q : I × J, L q := by
      funext t ω
      simp only [M, Finset.sum_apply]
    rw [hEq]
    exact hMart Finset.univ
  have hZero (ω : Ω) : M 0 ω = 0 := by
    simp only [M, L, itoIntegralProcess_at_zero, Pi.zero_apply, Finset.sum_const_zero]
  refine ⟨θ, ?_, hM, hZero, ?_⟩
  · filter_upwards [hRange] with ω hr q t
    rw [hθ]
    dsimp only [W, e]
    rw [coe_restrictState_of_mem fallback (hr _ (min_le_right _ _))]

steps.title: Recover the derivative on the actual vectors
steps.text: The finite limits sum in measure. Expand the derivative on the actual increment in its basis, and move the finite drift sum inside the time integral using bounded weights and integrable drift sections.
steps.lean:
let t (n : ℕ) := regularGridTimes (dyadicMesh T n) (2 ^ n)
  have ht (n : ℕ) (i : Fin (2 ^ n + 1)) : t n i ≤ T :=
    ((regularGridTimes_strictMono (dyadicMesh_pos hT n) _).monotone (Fin.le_last i)).trans_eq
      (regularDyadic_last_time T n)
  let F (i : I) := weightedIncrementSum T (W i) (A i)
  let G (q : I × J) := weightedIncrementSum T (W q.1) (N q)
  let D (i : I) (ω : Ω) := ∫ s, W i s ω * b i s ω ∂(TimeMeasure.upTo T)
  have hFromProg {P : ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℝ} (h : IsStronglyProgressive filtration P)
      (s : ℝ≥0) (_ : s ≤ T) : AEStronglyMeasurable (P s) μ :=
    ((h.stronglyAdapted s).mono (filtration.le s)).aestronglyMeasurable
  have hFm (i : I) (n : ℕ) : AEStronglyMeasurable (F i n) μ :=
    aestronglyMeasurable_weightedIncrementSum hT (hFromProg (hWp i)) (hFromProg (hAp i)) n
  have hGm (q : I × J) (n : ℕ) : AEStronglyMeasurable (G q n) μ :=
    aestronglyMeasurable_weightedIncrementSum hT (hFromProg (hWp q.1)) (fun s _ =>
      ((itoIntegralProcess_stronglyAdapted (η q.1 q.2) hT ((coordinateFamily hB).isBrownian q.2)
        hUsual s).mono (filtration.le s)).aestronglyMeasurable) n
  have hF (i : I) : TendstoInMeasure μ (F i) atTop (D i) := by
    apply tendstoInMeasure_of_tendsto_ae (hFm i)
    filter_upwards [hWc i, hbi i] with ω hw hi
    have hlim := tendsto_dyadic_weighted_prefixIntegral_sums
      (fun s => W i s ω) (fun s => b i s ω) T hT hw hi
    refine (tendsto_congr' (Eventually.of_forall fun n => ?_)).2 hlim
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro k _
    rw [hAeq i _ (ht n k.succ) ω, hAeq i _ (ht n k.castSucc) ω,
      add_sub_add_left_eq_sub]
  have hG (q : I × J) : TendstoInMeasure μ (G q) atTop (L q T) := hN q
  have hSum : TendstoInMeasure μ
      (fun n ω => (∑ i : I, F i n ω) + ∑ q : I × J, G q n ω) atTop
      (fun ω => (∑ i : I, D i ω) + M T ω) := by
    let S : I ⊕ (I × J) → ℕ → Ω → ℝ := Sum.elim F G
    let Q : I ⊕ (I × J) → Ω → ℝ := Sum.elim D (fun q => L q T)
    have hS (k : I ⊕ (I × J)) (n : ℕ) : AEStronglyMeasurable (S k n) μ := by
      cases k with
      | inl i => exact hFm i n
      | inr q => exact hGm q n
    have hQ (k : I ⊕ (I × J)) : TendstoInMeasure μ (S k) atTop (Q k) := by
      cases k with
      | inl i => exact hF i
      | inr q => exact hG q
    simpa only [S, Q, Fintype.sum_sum_type, Sum.elim_inl, Sum.elim_inr, M] using
      tendstoInMeasure_fintype_sum hS hQ
  have hExpand (l : EuclideanSpace ℝ I →L[ℝ] ℝ) (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ I) :
      l v = ∑ i : I, l (e i) * v i := by
    have h : (∑ i : I, v i • e i) = v := by
      simpa only [e, EuclideanSpace.basisFun_repr] using e.sum_repr v
    calc
      l v = l (∑ i : I, v i • e i) := congrArg l h.symm
      _ = _ := by simp only [map_sum, map_smul, smul_eq_mul, mul_comm]
  refine TendstoInMeasure.congr ?_ ?_ hSum
  · intro n
    filter_upwards [hRange] with ω hr
    simp only [F, G, weightedIncrementSum, Fintype.sum_prod_type]
    change ((∑ i : I, ∑ k : Fin (2 ^ n), W i (t n k.castSucc) ω *
      (A i (t n k.succ) ω - A i (t n k.castSucc) ω)) +
      ∑ i : I, ∑ j : J, ∑ k : Fin (2 ^ n), W i (t n k.castSucc) ω *
        (N (i, j) (t n k.succ) ω - N (i, j) (t n k.castSucc) ω)) =
      ∑ k : Fin (2 ^ n), fderiv ℝ f (X (t n k.castSucc) ω)
        (X (t n k.succ) ω - X (t n k.castSucc) ω)
    have hSwap (i : I) : (∑ j : J, ∑ k : Fin (2 ^ n), W i (t n k.castSucc) ω *
        (N (i, j) (t n k.succ) ω - N (i, j) (t n k.castSucc) ω)) =
        ∑ k : Fin (2 ^ n), ∑ j : J, W i (t n k.castSucc) ω *
          (N (i, j) (t n k.succ) ω - N (i, j) (t n k.castSucc) ω) := Finset.sum_comm
    simp_rw [hSwap]
    simp_rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro k _
    rw [hExpand]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i _
    rw [← Finset.mul_sum, ← mul_add, Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    simp only [W, min_eq_left (ht n k.castSucc),
      coe_restrictState_of_mem fallback (hr _ (ht n k.castSucc)), X, PiLp.sub_apply, N]
    ring
  · filter_upwards [ae_all_iff.2 hWc, ae_all_iff.2 hbi, hRange] with ω hw hi hr
    let ν := TimeMeasure.upTo T
    have hMem : ∀ᵐ s ∂ν, s ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ≥0) T :=
      (TimeMeasure.ae_mem_Ioc_zero_upTo T).mono fun _ hs => ⟨hs.1.le, hs.2⟩
    have hRest : ν.restrict (Icc 0 T) = ν := Measure.restrict_eq_self_of_ae_mem hMem
    have hInt (i : I) : Integrable (fun s => W i s ω * b i s ω) ν := by
      have hm : AEStronglyMeasurable (fun s => W i s ω) ν := by
        rw [← hRest]
        exact (hw i).aestronglyMeasurable measurableSet_Icc
      exact (hi i).bdd_mul hm (hMem.mono fun s hs => by
        simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using hC i s hs.2 ω)
    apply congrArg (· + M T ω)
    change (∑ i : I, ∫ s, W i s ω * b i s ω ∂ν) =
      ∫ s, fderiv ℝ f (X s ω) (WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i : I => b i s ω)) ∂ν
    rw [← integral_finsetSum _ (fun i _ => hInt i)]
    apply integral_congr_ae
    filter_upwards [hMem] with s hs
    rw [hExpand]
    simp only [W, min_eq_left hs.2, coe_restrictState_of_mem fallback (hr s hs.2)]

lesson.lean_statement: The stochastic limit gives progressive integrands that equal the actual derivative-weighted entries for all coordinates and times almost surely. The martingale starts at zero pointwise.
lesson.lean_proof: Combine the exact time and stochastic weighted limits and identify the resulting sums with the derivative applied to the full vector.
